get.summary: List device pricing with computed prices
get.description:
Paginated catalog listing for the pricing screen. Returns parent models with their class data plus derived goodPrice and age-bucket prices (price_3_6, price_6_11, price_11_plus). Variant-level filters (storage/ram/class/price) are resolved back to their parent rows.

**Notes:** Watch groups its variants by baseURL, everything else by modelCode. Laptop has no parent/variant split. No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/devicePricing/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: deviceType
parameters.description: Mobile (default when omitted), Tablet, Laptop, Mac, Watch, Console, Camera or Headphone.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on brand, model or baseURL.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: createdAt lower bound; only applied together with toDate.

put.summary: Update one device's price or class
put.description:
Updates the price and/or classId of a single catalog row and returns it with recomputed age-bucket prices. Records a PriceHistory row when the price actually changes.

**Notes:** Changes the price quoted to customers. Console stores price as a varchar and is coerced automatically. PriceHistory is written with changedBy 'Admin', changeType 'manual'. No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/devicePricing/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.error: At least one of classId or price must be provided

patch.summary: Bulk update device prices or classes
patch.description:
Applies price and/or classId updates to many catalog rows of one device type in a single call, returning per-row successes and errors. Each price change also writes a PriceHistory row.

**Notes:** Mass mutation of customer-facing prices, not transactional (partial failures are reported per row). PriceHistory changeType is 'bulk'. No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/devicePricing/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.error: Missing required fields: deviceType and updates array are required

get.summary: List brands for a device type
get.description:
Returns the distinct, non-empty brand names present in the catalog table for the given device type, sorted alphabetically.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/devicePricing/brands/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: deviceType
parameters.description: One of Mobile, Tablet, Laptop, Mac, Desktop, Camera, Headphone, Console, Watch, Drone, TV, AC. 400 if missing; an unknown type returns an empty list.

get.summary: List class options for a device type
get.description:
Returns id and classType pairs for the class dropdown of the pricing table. Supported types are Mobile, Tablet, Laptop, Mac, Console, Camera, Watch and Headphone.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/devicePricing/classes/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: deviceType
parameters.description: Device type. 400 if missing or unsupported.

get.summary: Export all devices of a type
get.description:
Returns every catalog row for Mobile, Tablet, Laptop or Mac with its class data attached, unpaginated, for spreadsheet export.

**Notes:** Unbounded read of the whole catalog table; heavy. No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/devicePricing/export/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: deviceType
parameters.description: Only Mobile, Tablet, Laptop and Mac are supported; anything else returns 400.

get.summary: Get price change history for a device
get.description:
Returns the last 50 PriceHistory rows for one device, newest first.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/devicePricing/history/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

post.description:
Manually inserts a PriceHistory row. Normally written automatically by the pricing PUT/PATCH handlers.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/devicePricing/history/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.error: deviceId, deviceType, oldPrice, and newPrice are required

get.description:
Counts Mobile/Tablet/Laptop/Mac catalog rows, how many lack a price or a class, price changes today and in the last 7 days, a 30-day change chart and price/class coverage percentages.

**Notes:** Every individual count is wrapped in its own try/catch, so a missing table degrades to zero instead of failing. No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/devicePricing/stats/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

get.summary: List variants of a parent device
get.description:
Returns the child variant rows of a parent model, each with its class data and W1-W4/B1-B2 coefficients spread onto it. Mobile/Tablet/Laptop/Mac match on modelCode; Watch matches on baseURL (case size axis). Non-variant types return an empty array.

**Notes:** Types outside Mobile/Tablet/Laptop/Mac/Watch return {success: true, variants: []} rather than an error. NextAuth session cookie required.

_Source: `app/api/devicePricing/variants/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

parameters.name: parentId
parameters.description: Parent catalog row id. Required unless modelCode is given, and always required for Watch.

parameters.name: modelCode
parameters.description: Parent model code; alternative to parentId for non-Watch types.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Parent model name; filters variants with a case-insensitive startsWith to avoid cross-model contamination.

post.summary: Create variants under a parent device
post.description:
Creates one or more child variant rows that inherit brand, images and SEO fields from the parent, naming each '<parent model> - <storage>GB/<ram>GB'. Only Mobile, Tablet, Laptop and Mac are accepted.

**Notes:** Creates rows one at a time, not transactionally. NextAuth session cookie required.

_Source: `app/api/devicePricing/variants/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

example.error: Variants are not supported for device type "Watch"

delete.description:
Permanently deletes a variant row from the catalog table for the given device type.

**Notes:** DELETE with a JSON body — the deviceType must be sent in the body, not the query string. NextAuth session cookie required.

_Source: `app/api/devicePricing/variants/[id]/route.ts`_

parameters.description: Id of the variant to delete

**Notes:** NextAuth session cookie (next-auth.session-token) required. Quirk: any deviceType other than Mobile/Tablet/Laptop is treated as Mac.

parameters.description: Id of the variant to duplicate

SuccessErrorDetailsEnvelope.description: Error envelope `{ success: false, error, details }` where `details` is a string.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Plain error envelope `{ error }` used by most routes. `error` is a human-readable message.

ErrorDetailsEnvelope.description: Error envelope `{ error, details }` where `details` is a string (usually the underlying exception message).

deviceType.description: Mobile, Tablet or Laptop; anything else falls through to the Mac table

variants.description: Array of {storage, ram, price, classId?} objects

deviceType.description: Mobile, Tablet, Laptop, Mac, Console, Camera, Watch or Headphone

updates.description: Non-empty array of {id, price?, classId?} objects

MessageEnvelope.description: Message-only envelope `{ message }`; used for both success and failure responses.

SuccessMessageEnvelope.description: Envelope `{ success, message }`; `success` is `true` on 2xx and `false` on error responses.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session (NextAuth cookie), or the expected token/secret is missing or wrong. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
